name: Radio Star
description: “Radio Star” is a South Korean music talk show where the guests and hosts talk openly and intimately about their lives, their pasts and their work. It is part of Munhwa Broadcasting Corporation's "Golden Fishery" programming block.

videos.title: Let's Meet in a Lively Way, Please~
Endless Energy
videos.overview: This week, Jang Young Ran, Ahn Hyun Mo, Hong Yun Hwa, and Kim Bo Reum visit the show. It is the Endless Energy special. Young Ran talks about her recent resurgence and parenting. Yun Hwa shares funny stories and comedy skits. Hyun Mo recalls her experiences of talking with foreign celebrities and officials. Bo Reum tells her foray into variety shows as an athlete.

videos.title: Fight for My Way
videos.overview: This week, Choi Soo-jong, Park Young-jin, Syuka, and Kwak Yoon-gy join the show. Soo-jong talks about starring in a period drama again, and his happy married life. Young-jin details the creeds of frugality, and how he implements them in his life. Syuka talks about his success as a financial content creator. Yoon-gy talks about balancing the life of an athlete and a content creator.
